name: Diamond
author: E. T. Carter
description: A raymarched flight through a Schwarz Diamond, a triply-periodic minimal surface with sharper, more crystalline chambers than the gyroid. The camera drifts through the lattice while thin walls catch a raking light with crisp silhouette edges, hue turning with depth and fading into fog. A sibling of the gyroid on the same 3D engine, with a colder, more faceted character.

params.label: Cell frequency
params.effect: How tightly the diamond tiles space — a few big chambers at the low end, a dense crystalline lattice at the high end.

params.label: Thickness
params.effect: Thickness of the surface walls — delicate membranes at 0, fat beams nearly closing the passages at 1.

params.label: Flight speed
params.effect: How fast the camera flies through the lattice — hovering at 0, rushing the tunnel at full.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Glow and rim light bleeding off the walls — a matte solid at 0, a luminous crystal at 1.

params.label: Warp
params.effect: How much the lattice bends out of perfect periodicity — a crisp crystal at 0, a melted cavern at 1.

params.label: Hue turn
params.effect: How fast colour turns with depth and angle — a single tint near 0, a full spectral journey at the high end.

params.label: Fog
params.effect: Depth fog swallowing the far lattice — a deep clear view at 0, a close fog-bound chamber at 1.

params.label: Roll
params.effect: Rolls the view around the flight axis, reorienting the lattice.

params.label: Shape
params.effect: Morphs the shape from the crystalline Schwarz Diamond (0) to the swirling gyroid (1), through hybrids between.

params.label: Edge line
params.effect: Strength and width of the crisp contour where a wall turns from view — soft lobes at 0, hard-outlined facets at 1.

params.label: Contour lines
params.effect: Topographic lines wrapping the surfaces — clean walls at 0, a ribbed relief at 1.

params.label: Twist
params.effect: Spirals the whole lattice around the flight axis — straight chambers at 0, a corkscrewing vortex of cells at 1.

params.label: Pocket
params.effect: Shifts the surface from thin minimal-surface walls (0) toward fat closed rounded pockets and tunnels (1) — the single biggest lever on the overall shape character.

params.label: Contour density
params.effect: How many contour lines wrap the surfaces — a few broad bands at the low end, a finely ribbed topographic relief packed with lines at the high end. Pair with Contour lines to set their strength.
